summary.name: BeatMusic
summary.one_liner: BeatMusic is an AI music generator that turns a mood, style, text idea or your lyrics into original songs with vocals.
use_cases: Creating soundtracks for YouTube, TikTok or Instagram videos
Making podcast intro, outro and background tracks
Generating royalty-free music for ads and presentations
Turning your own lyrics into a sung track
summary.what_it_does: The page describes BeatMusic as a web-based AI tool where users describe a mood, genre or style, or supply lyrics, and get a generated song with vocals. It lists over 50 genres such as cinematic, electronic, pop, jazz and classical, and says tracks can be adjusted for length, tempo, mood and instruments. Named extra tools include a vocal remover, AI cover and lyrics generator, and the page mentions uploading MP3 or WAV files as a starting step. Output is described as downloadable in high-quality audio.
notable: Turns lyrics or a text description into full songs with vocals
Claims royalty-free output for commercial use, including monetized video
Includes vocal remover, AI cover and lyrics generator tools
Offers 50+ genres and tempo, mood and instrument customization
caveats: Page says flexible subscription models exist; specific paid tier limits and prices are not listed
Page describes a free tier and free trial but does not detail its limits
Licensing and output quality claims are marketing statements not independently verified on the page
